triggers.name: new_updated_record
triggers.title: New/updated record
triggers.help: Triggers when a record of the selected Hive object type, e.g. project, is created/updated. Created/updated events for records are fetched as soon as they occur. Select the object type to trigger on, then select the events you want to allow to fire this trigger (created, updated, or both). If you'd l…

input.name: trigger_object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own Hive action with a HTTP request.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: apply_action_template
actions.title: Apply action template
actions.help: Apply an action template to an existing action by passing its ID.

actions.name: create_record
actions.title: Create record
actions.help: Create record in Hive. Select the object type to create, then provide data for creating the record.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.title: Delete record
actions.help: Delete record in Hive. Select the object type to delete, then provide its Hive ID.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.

actions.name: get_record_by_id
actions.title: Get record details by ID
actions.description: Get details of specific record in Hive
actions.help: Retrieve the details of a specific record via its Hive ID. Select the object type to retrieve the details of, then provide its Hive ID.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.

actions.name: list_records
actions.title: List records
actions.help: Retrieves a full list of records from your Hive workspace. Select the object type for the list you want to retrieve, then this Workato Action will output the list upon execution.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.

actions.name: update_record
actions.title: Update record
actions.help: Update record in Hive. Select the object type to update, then provide data for updating the record.

input.name: object_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select any Hive object, e.g. project.
